response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, which makes him significantly overqualified and mismatched for an entry-level Junior Java Developer role. His core stack is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang rather than Java, and his German is listed as only 'Basic', falling short of the strong verbal/written German required for client-facing insurance consulting work.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and cross-domain software engineering experience (web, mobile, embedded, infra)
Deep familiarity with agile/software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based dev)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshop experience
concerns: Severely overqualified for a junior/entry-level position, raising retention and engagement risk
German proficiency listed as only 'Basic', not meeting the required strong verbal/written German
Java is a minor, dated skill; recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js rather than Java or insurance-domain projects

key_factors.factor: Limited/dated Java experience vs. required OOP proficiency
